title: TSMC Collaborates to Expand Large-Format Photomasks for High NA EUV
why_it_matters_hint: Larger photomasks would be a step toward using High NA EUV lithography, the next generation of chip patterning tools, in volume.
notes: qz.com returned HTTP 403 for the main session and again on retry. Google News RSS searches (photomask TSMC, High NA EUV, 'large-format photomasks', 7-day window) found no other outlet carrying this story; Quartz's own RSS feed does not list it. Headline only.
